author: Hillsborough Sun
title: Kristin Noble highlights Wellheart Charter School opening and discusses education priorities
text:
Kristin Noble, New Hampshire Representative for Hillsborough 2nd District | www.facebook.com
Kristin Noble, New Hampshire Representative for Hillsborough 2nd District | www.facebook.com
Kristin Noble, a New Hampshire State Representative, used her social media account on August 6, 2025, to share perspectives on education and local representatives in the state.
In an early morning post, Noble promoted a new educational institution in Merrimack: "If you are looking for a different type of learning experience for your kids the Wellheart Charter School is opening soon in Merrimack. Check them out!" (August 6, 2025).
Later that day, she expressed appreciation for her colleagues: "We really are blessed in NH to have so many awesome reps " (August 6, 2025).
Addressing educational priorities in another post that afternoon, Noble stated: "Any school that focuses on academics, eliminates the culture war crap and stops messing with kid’s mental health, is going to rise to the top. This is how you compete." (August 6, 2025).
Charter schools like Wellheart Charter School offer alternative public education options and operate under a charter or contract with oversight from state or local authorities. In New Hampshire, such schools are part of ongoing discussions about educational choice and curriculum standards.
